name: Secure Data Analyst Skill Suite
description: A secure data analysis workflow suite based on MGC Blackbox 1.5.4+, providing credential protection, zero-exposure script & workflow application, workflow / skill-package sealed-authorization collaboration, and knowledge management. Supports 1.5.4 double-layer encryption with link authorization, free-mode sealing, and cross-folder workflow auto-recognition. Includes a Data Analyst Agent system prompt template.
author: MirginCipher Team

agent_template.name: Secure Data Analyst Agent
agent_template.description: A system prompt template for building a secure Data Analyst Agent; every sensitive operation requires explicit user authorization.

disclaimers: This skill suite provides no automated data-access capability; all scripts must be user-owned.
All sensitive operations require explicit user authorization.
Scripts must comply with the organization's security and compliance policies.
MGC protects content confidentiality; after unsealing, scripts execute with the permissions of the running user and their runtime behavior is outside MGC's control.
